annotations.title: Make an earlier version current again

description: Bring back an earlier version of a page as a new version on the same review link. Nothing is deleted: every version and its comments stay in the version menu. Free pages keep up to 3 versions, so on Free this fails once a page has 3. Confirm the version number with the user first.

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page, like https://htmlannotate.com/manage/<page>#k=<key>

note.description: Optional short note for that email.

notify_reviewers.description: Email everyone who commented that a new version is ready. Ask the user first. Default false.

version.description: The earlier version to bring back, as shown by list_versions.

name: restore_version
title: Make an earlier version current again
